scale: ore_ont_8737 of the ORE 2015 DL development set, GO 2026-07-26, ChEBI lite 256, ore_ont_3836 and ore_ont_13482 of the ORE 2015 EL sample on atlas

sides.base: 3a1b9b04, the lane's base, lane/dl-897-727 with item 818 and the main of batch 20
sides.c3: 1da472f2, one copy of a run for all its destinations, the inlined check of a run and the batch applied in place, the lane's final saturation code
sides.c4: 79b0c707, c3 with the open-addressing table of Small and the fix of review round 1, reverted in bfa3401b since it measured no faster

manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley at each commit, stripped and copied to atlas
manifest.profiles: prof889.sh profiled base and c4 with their symbols kept, perf 7.3.1, cpu-clock:u at 999 Hz, ore_ont_8737 on four threads

settings.memory_runs: three rounds of rotating order, one el_classify process per side and thread count in a 13 GiB scope, no swap, no pinning, wall time, CPU time and peak RSS from GNU time
settings.ab_runs: ab.sh, six rounds of rotating order, five classifications per process, one-thread runs pinned to CPU 4 and the others to CPUs 0-11

method: Every part ran under ~/lanes/.heavy.lock on atlas with no other benchmark or gate on the host. slot889.sh ran three rounds of one classification of ore_ont_8737 per side on 4, 12 and 1 threads, then ab.sh with six rounds of rotating order, one process per side, file and thread count with --repeat 5, whose median classification is the round's value. On every side the Horn attempt of ore_ont_8737 passes its memory budget and the classifier classifies again by the EL rules alone (roadmap item 962), so saturation_s is the saturation of that second run and classify_s includes the attempt. The stanley member holds the profiles, the interleaved rounds and the taxonomy sweep taken on the laptop while other work ran there, so only their shares, ratios and hashes are evidence.

stanley.host: stanley, Intel Core Ultra X7 358H, 16 cores, 30 GiB, other lanes builds and tests running (load 4 to 21)
stanley.note: approximate timings; the laptop was shared, so only the profile shares, the ratios and the taxonomy hashes are evidence

sides.s2: c0ed358e content (s1 with the inlined run check)
sides.s3: 1da472f2 content (s2 with the batch applied in place)
sides.s4: 715f4a26 content (s3 with the open-addressing table, before its fix)

stanley.profile_note: perf 7.3.1 record -e cpu-clock:u -F 999, ore_ont_8737 on four threads, one run per side; the samples include the Horn attempt

taxonomy_sweep.files: the 298 ORE 2015 EL files, GO, ChEBI lite and ore_ont_8737
